files.report.html:
← 返回照片分析

BLINK RESEARCH · 可重現的研究紀錄

每一版，都用同一套標準比較。

目前結論

保留測試集 macro-F1 差異：+4.2 個百分點。配對重抽樣 95% 區間：[+1.0, +8.4]。 通過預設研究門檻。

這是局部「是否覆蓋資料集標註病灶」的研究任務，不是四類膚況或醫療診斷準確率。研究權重尚未替換正式照片分析模型。

實測比較

版本資料分組局部數Macro-F1陽性精確率陽性召回率JSON 合格率延遲中位數
原始模型validation4876.8%72.4%87.5%100.0%0.54s
lora-r8-epoch1validation4876.8%72.4%87.5%100.0%0.60s
lora-r8-epoch2validation4878.6%71.9%95.8%100.0%0.60s
lora-r16-epoch2validation4881.2%77.8%87.5%100.0%0.64s
原始模型locked test9685.4%82.7%89.6%100.0%0.56s
驗證集選出的最佳版本locked test9689.6%88.0%91.7%100.0%0.62s

資料與判斷標準

train：128 張來源影像／256 個局部裁切；val：24 張來源影像／48 個局部裁切；test：48 張來源影像／96 個局部裁切

  • 影像與標註：ACNE04 原作者框選，使用固定版本的公開鏡像；學術研究限定。
  • 先依來源影像及近似重複群組分組，再裁切。驗證集選版本，保留測試集只比較原始與最終版本。
  • 無法解析的輸出也計為錯誤；不把拒答直接排除。
  • 門檻：test macro-F1 ≥80%、陽性精確率 ≥85%、比原始 macro-F1 增加至少3個百分點、JSON合格率 ≥98%。
  • 預先限定三個候選版本，每個最多兩輪；沒有改善就保留原始模型。

結果的適用範圍

資料沒有可靠的人物識別碼，無法宣稱已做到不同人物完全分離。未覆蓋標註框的局部不等於經醫師確認的正常皮膚；可能包含背景或漏標。泛紅、色沉、脫屑及實際使用者照片尚未驗證。

小型試驗的成績不能代表臨床表現。調參不使用保留測試集的錯誤案例；下一輪須另立版本與保留資料。

來源：原始研究 · 資料鏡像

← 返回照片分析

BLINK RESEARCH · 2026-10-31

訓練有沒有更好，讓數據回答。

評估範圍

局部照片是否包含 ACNE04 資料集框選病灶。原始框選是作者提供；未框選局部不代表經醫師確認正常。這份成績不能當成泛紅、色沉、脫屑或疾病診斷準確率。

兩輪的資料抽樣方式不同，請在各輪內比較原始模型與微調模型。所有研究權重保留在研究環境，網站四類照片分析仍使用原模型。

下載完整比較 CSV ↘

第一輪：框選衍生局部

train：128 張來源／256 個局部；val：24 張來源／48 個局部；test：48 張來源／96 個局部

通過此局部研究任務的預設門檻，仍須另行驗證真實照片與四類膚況。

保留測試 F1：85.4% → 89.6%　誤報 9 → 6；漏判 5 → 4。

差異：+4.2 個百分點；配對來源影像重抽樣 95% 區間 [+1.0, +8.4]。

事先固定的判斷標準

  • 先按來源影像及近似重複群組切分，再裁切；同一來源的局部不跨組。
  • 驗證集選參數與 checkpoint，保留測試集只比較原始模型與驗證集選出的版本。
  • 無法解析的輸出也算錯誤，不排除拒答來美化成績。
  • 門檻：test macro-F1 ≥80%、精確率 ≥85%、F1 增加至少3個百分點、JSON合格率 ≥98%。另報告配對重抽樣區間，區間跨零不宣稱已證實改善。
  • 第一輪三組設定；第二輪修正陰性裁切並加入語言 MLP、翻轉增強，最多兩個 epoch。兩輪完成即停止，不無限消耗 GPU。

這次如何修正

第一輪抽查16個訓練陰性局部，其中3個主要是背景或衣服。第二輪挑選與陽性局部顏色接近、距離較近且不覆蓋任何原始標註框的陰性局部，並排除前輪全部保留測試來源。第二輪同樣抽查16個訓練陰性局部，仍有1個主要是背景或衣服。抽查由助手做視覺品管，不是醫師重新標註。顏色配對不是已驗證的皮膚分割，仍可能有漏標與背景混雜。

版面：相同特徵合併，部位用標籤呈現，各部位原始描述保留在可展開區域；判讀限制與補充問題合併到下一步。三部位同類特徵由3張卡片整理成1項，3份依據皆保留。

切回完整照片報告的相容性檢查

以公開例圖、兩張作者保留影像與控制圖檢查格式和拒絕行為；此處沒有四類自然語言標註，不能當成膚況準確率。低對比控制圖由既有規則先行拒絕。

目前證據的限制

資料缺可靠人物ID，僅能確認來源影像與近似重複群組分離，不能保證人物完全分離。這是單一訓練 seed 的小型研究，局部裁切不等於實際全臉照片。第二輪同時變更陰性取樣、語言 MLP、翻轉增強和決策 loss，尚未逐項消融，不能將增益單獨歸因於某一項。延遲是共用 MI300X 上單一局部的暖機推論時間，不含模型載入、前處理與網站往返。

ACNE04 限學術研究；商業用途須另洽原作者。未使用使用者上傳照片訓練。

files.data/raw/MIRROR_README.md:
--- language: - en license: other license_name: acne04-academic-use-only license_link: https://github.com/xpwu95/LDL pretty_name: "ACNE04" tags: - medical - dermatology - acne - severity-grading - object-detection - image-classification - computer-vision task_categories: - image-classification - object-detection size_categories: - 1KACNE04

1,457 facial acne photographs, rebuilt from the original ACNE04 release with clean image/label separation, verified 4-level Hayashi severity grades, and 18,983 lesion-level bounding box annotations.

   

--- ## Overview This dataset packages the full ACNE04 corpus, 1,457 facial photographs graded for acne severity on the 4-level Hayashi scale, as a single, ready-to-load Hugging Face dataset. Every image is embedded directly in the parquet files alongside its full label set: severity grade (`level`/`severity`), the original lesion-count bucket label from the paper, and per-image lesion bounding boxes (18,983 total across the dataset). All 5 cross-validation folds used in the original paper are preserved as explicit train/test membership columns, plus a canonical `split` column (fold 0) for anyone who just wants a single train/test split. The source images and labels come straight from the official release linked from the [xpwu95/LDL](https://github.com/xpwu95/LDL) GitHub repository (`Classification.tar` for images and grade labels, `Detection.tar` for the Pascal VOC lesion bounding boxes). Nothing was re-annotated or re-graded; the severity grades and lesion boxes are the original authors' annotations, joined row by row into a single table. ## Statement of Need ACNE04 is normally distributed as two separate tar archives hosted on Google Drive (Classification: images + five pairs of plain-text train/test label files for 5-fold CV; Detection: a parallel Pascal VOC XML tree of lesion bounding boxes), which have to be manually downloaded, matched by filename, and joined. Several ACNE04 mirrors circulating on the Hub are incomplete (as few as 394 of the 1,457 images), drop the lesion bounding box annotations entirely, or repurpose the label files for unrelated tasks (e.g. text-to-image prompt captions) with no severity grade preserved. This dataset fixes that: the complete, original 1,457-image corpus, severity grades and lesion boxes joined per image, and every one of the paper's 5 CV folds retained so results are reproducible against the published benchmark. ## Intended Use Intended for training and evaluating acne severity classification and lesion-detection models; benchmarking zero-shot or fine-tuned multimodal / VLM models on dermatological severity grading against the Hayashi ground truth; and research into scaling behavior, cost-efficiency, or bias in dermatology imaging AI. Suitable for academic research and model benchmarking. Not intended for clinical deployment or diagnostic use; this is a research dataset, not a validated clinical decision-support tool, and models trained on it should not be used to inform real patient care. ## Limitations Ground truth reflects the original annotators' Hayashi grading from the source study and was not independently re-adjudicated. `lesion_count_label` is the raw label from the paper's text files and combines lesion count with severity bucket in a way that isn't fully documented by the original authors; use `level`/`severity` as the primary severity label. The 5 test folds are close to but not a perfectly disjoint partition of the 1,457 images (a handful of images appear in more than one fold's test set, a property of the original release, not introduced here); the canonical `split` column uses fold 0 only, which is a clean single split. Images vary in resolution, lighting, and framing since they were collected as routine clinical photographs, not under standardized imaging conditions. ## Dataset Structure ### Splits | Split (canonical, fold 0) | Images | |-------|--------| | train | 1,165 | | test | 292 | ### Severity distribution | Severity | Level | Count | |----------|-------|-------| | mild | 0 | 513 | | moderate | 1 | 633 | | severe | 2 | 182 | | very_severe | 3 | 129 | ### Features | Column | Type | Description | |--------|------|--------------| | `image` | `Image` | The face photo. | | `file_name` | `string` | Original filename. | | `level` | `int32` | **Primary label.** Hayashi severity grade, 0-3. | | `severity` | `string` | Human-readable grade name (`mild`, `moderate`, `severe`, `very_severe`). | | `lesion_count_label` | `int32` | Original lesion-count bucket label from the paper's label files. | | `num_lesions_annotated` | `int32` | Number of lesion bounding boxes annotated for this image. | | `lesion_boxes` | `struct` | Per-lesion bounding boxes as parallel lists: `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax` (pixel coordinates). Empty lists if no lesions were boxed. | | `split` | `string` | `train`/`test`, canonical split (fold 0). | | `fold_0_split` … `fold_4_split` | `string` | `train`/`test` membership for each of the paper's 5 CV folds. | ## Usage ```python from datasets import load_dataset ds = load_dataset("Layered-Labs/ACNE04") print(ds) example = ds["train"][0] example["image"].show() print("severity:", example["severity"], "(level", example["level"], ")") print("lesion boxes:", example["num_lesions_annotated"]) ``` ### Example: canonical train/test split ```python train = ds["train"].filter(lambda r: r["split"] == "train") test = ds["train"].filter(lambda r: r["split"] == "test") print(len(train), len(test)) ``` ### Example: full 5-fold cross-validation ```python for fold in range(5): col = f"fold_{fold}_split" fold_train = ds["train"].filter(lambda r: r[col] == "train") fold_test = ds["train"].filter(lambda r: r[col] == "test") print(fold, len(fold_train), len(fold_test)) ``` ## Citation If you use this dataset, please cite both this release and the original ACNE04 source: ```bibtex @dataset{layeredlabs2026acne04, title = {ACNE04}, author = {Ridwan, Abdullah and Hossain, Radhyyah and Noor, Saniya}, year = {2026}, publisher = {Hugging Face}, url = {https://huggingface.co/datasets/Layered-Labs/ACNE04}, note = {Images and labels rebuilt from the original ACNE04 release} } @inproceedings{wu2019joint, title = {Joint acne image grading and counting via label distribution learning}, author = {Wu, Xiaoping and Wen, Ni and Liang, Jie and Lai, Yu-Kun and She, Dongyu and Cheng, Ming-Ming and Yang, Jufeng}, booktitle = {Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision}, pages = {10642--10651}, year = {2019} } ``` ## License The underlying ACNE04 dataset is released by the original authors for **academic/research use only**. For any other use, contact the original author, Xiaoping Wu (xpwu95@163.com), per the terms stated in the [official repository](https://github.com/xpwu95/LDL). This repackaging carries forward the same restriction: do not use this dataset for commercial purposes. Maintained by [Layered Labs](https://layeredlabs.ai).
